item.title: Hearst promotes Christopher Martinez to VP, Advanced Advertising
item.description: Hearst Television has promoted Christopher Martinez to the newly created role of Vice President, Advanced Advertising.

item.title: Charter names John Lee as Head of Intelligence Ventures
item.description: Charter Communications has named John Lee as Head of Intelligence Ventures, establishing a new leadership role focused on developing data- and AI-driven products and partnerships.

item.title: What makes a streaming service unique? Viewers don't know, Hub survey reveals
item.description: A new consumer survey from Hub Entertainment Research finds that most streamers are unable to explain clearly to others what separates one service from another.

item.title: Nexstar to operate TEGNA as subsidiary business while lawsuits proceed
item.description: The move will allow Nexstar to spin-out TEGNA if lawsuits are successful; on Monday, Newsmax and several broadband groups filed a request for a preliminary injunction.

item.title: Gray Media gets FCC approval to acquire Allen Media TV stations
item.description: The FCC has approved the transfer of 10 local television broadcast licenses from Allen Media Group to peer broadcaster Gray Media.

item.title: Hearst stations to carry Tampa Bay Rays baseball games
item.description: Hearst Television has secured a new agreement with the Tampa Bay Rays to air a package of games across four Florida markets during the 2026 Major League Baseball season.

item.title: Comcast pulls Scripps-owned channels from Xfinity TV
item.description: It's no April Fool's joke — some Comcast customers woke up to find one or more of their favorite TV stations missing from their Xfinity TV packages early Wednesday morning.

item.title: Televisa-Univision renews measurement deal with Nielsen
item.description: April 2, 2026 - Televisa-Univision has renewed its measurement partnership with Nielsen under a new multi-year agreement that expands audience measurement and data services across its portfolio of broadcast, cable, streaming and radio properties.

item.title: Main Street Sports to pull plug on FanDuel Sports Network
item.description: The closure impacts 13 NBA teams and six NHL teams that must find new local broadcast partners.

item.title: NAB Leadership Foundation adds Valari Staab, Todd Hartman to board
item.description: April 3, 2026 - The appointments were announced this week by NABLF President Michelle Duke, who said both executives bring extensive experience across broadcast, digital media and strategic transactions.

item.title: Fox News tops competitors in Q1 YouTube viewership
item.description: Fox News Media recorded 1.5 billion YouTube video views during the first quarter of 2026, the highest among major news organizations, according to data from Emplifi.

item.title: Fox's WTTG, Gray Media to offer Washington Nationals games
item.description: Fox Television Stations and Gray Media will offer some locally-televised games from the Washington Nationals this season.

item.title: FCC renews AM radio station license, despite multiple rules violations
item.description: The station, WABG (960 AM), will remain on the air under a consent decree that resolves the investigation and requires a series of compliance measures.

item.title: Globo taps Synamedia for IP-based video distribution
item.description: April 3, 2026 - The ZapperBox allows TV fans to watch ATSC and NextGen TV broadcast signals. (Photo via Zapperbox storefront, Graphic by The Desk) Synamedia said this week that Globo has completed a transition of its primary content distribution to Secure Reliable Transport (SRT), marking a significant shift to a fully IP-based infrastructure.…

item.title: Sinclair to FCC: Sports rights drive investments in local TV news
item.description: Sinclair has told the FCC that its ability to continue offering local news at its TV stations is predicated on continued airing of premium sports programming.
